exercises.title: WU 听力·对话 Booking a Flight
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Clerk: Good morning. How can I help you?
Tom: Hi, I'd like to book a flight to Lima next month.
Clerk: Sure. When would you like to leave?
Tom: On the fifteenth, in the morning if possible.
Clerk: There's a flight at nine. It costs 600 dollars.
Tom: That's fine. Do I need a visa for Peru?
Clerk: Yes, you should apply for one early.
Tom: OK, thank you very much.
exercises.translation_cn: Tom 想订下月去利马的机票;职员问出发日期,Tom 要15号上午;有班9点的、600美元;Tom 问秘鲁要不要签证,职员说要、且要早申请;Tom 道谢。

questions.stem: Where does Tom want to fly to?
When does Tom want to leave?
options: On the fifteenth, in the morning.

questions.stem: How much is the flight?
What does Tom ask about?
What does the clerk advise about the visa?

exercises.title: WU 听力·短文 My Trip to Peru
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Last summer I visited Peru with my family.
We flew to Lima and then took a train into the mountains.
Our main destination was Machu Picchu, an ancient city of the Inca.
We hiked up a narrow path to reach it.
The view from the top was amazing, and I will never forget it.
exercises.translation_cn: 去年夏天我和家人去了秘鲁;先飞到利马,再坐火车进山;主要目的地是印加古城马丘比丘;我们沿狭窄小路爬上去;山顶的景色令人惊叹,我永远忘不了。

questions.stem: When did the speaker visit Peru?
How did they get into the mountains?
What was their main destination?
How did they reach the ancient city?
options: They hiked up a narrow path.

questions.stem: How did the speaker feel about the view?

exercises.title: WU 听力·对话 Checking In at the Hotel
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Guest: Hello, I have a booking under the name Green.
Clerk: Welcome. Yes, a room for three nights.
Guest: That's right. Could I have a room with a view?
Clerk: Of course. Room 502 looks out over the lake.
Guest: Wonderful. What time is breakfast?
Clerk: From seven to nine in the morning.
Guest: Great. And when do we have to check out?
Clerk: Before noon on the last day. Here is your key.
exercises.translation_cn: 客人以 Green 的名字订了三晚;想要带景观的房间;职员给 502、能看到湖;问早餐时间,7点到9点;问几点退房,最后一天中午前;给钥匙。

questions.stem: How many nights is the booking for?
What kind of room does the guest ask for?
What can the guest see from Room 502?
When is breakfast served?
options: From seven to nine in the morning.

questions.stem: When must the guest check out?
options: Before noon on the last day.
After three days of extra stay.

exercises.title: WU 听力·短文 Why I Love Hiking
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: My favourite way to travel is hiking.
I like to walk slowly and enjoy the quiet of the mountains.
Hiking is good for my health and clears my mind.
Sometimes the path is steep and my bag feels heavy.
But the amazing views at the top are always worth it.
exercises.translation_cn: 我最喜欢的旅行方式是徒步;喜欢慢慢走、享受山里的宁静;徒步有益健康、能让头脑放空;有时路陡、背包很重;但山顶的美景总是值得的。

questions.stem: What is the speaker's favourite way to travel?
Why does the speaker like to walk slowly?
options: To enjoy the quiet of the mountains.

questions.stem: What is one benefit of hiking the speaker mentions?
options: It is good for health and the mind.

questions.stem: What does the speaker say can be difficult?
options: The steep path and heavy bag.

questions.stem: What makes the difficulty worth it?
options: The amazing views at the top.

exercises.title: WU 听力·对话 Asking for Directions
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Visitor: Excuse me, how can I get to the old castle?
Local: It's not far. Walk straight along this street.
Visitor: And then?
Local: Turn left at the bank, and you'll see a narrow path.
Visitor: Should I take a bus?
Local: No need. It's only ten minutes on foot.
Visitor: Great. Thank you so much for your help.
Local: You're welcome. Enjoy the view from the top!
exercises.translation_cn: 游客问怎么去古堡;当地人说不远,沿这条街直走;然后在银行左转,会看到一条窄路;游客问要不要坐公交,当地人说不用,步行只要十分钟;游客道谢,当地人让他好好欣赏山顶景色。

questions.stem: Where does the visitor want to go?
What should the visitor do at the bank?
Does the visitor need to take a bus?
options: No, it's only ten minutes on foot.

questions.stem: How long does it take to walk there?
What does the local person wish the visitor?
options: To enjoy the view from the top.

exercises.title: WU 听力·短文 A Tip for Travellers
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who loves travelling.
Before you leave, learn a few words of the local language.
Even just "hello" and "thank you" can make a big difference.
Local people are always pleased when visitors make the effort.
A few kind words often open the door to new friends.
exercises.translation_cn: 给爱旅行的人一个小贴士:出发前学几句当地语言;哪怕只是"你好"和"谢谢"也大不一样;当地人见到游客努力尝试总是很高兴;几句友善的话常能为你打开结识新朋友的大门。

questions.stem: What is the tip about?
options: Learning a few words of the local language.
